title: 第9章 法天象地第10章 日游神
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
七位星君入殿。
但见那九龙御座之下，早已立了六道身影。为首者身着鸾金星袍，头戴紫微冠，腰悬六芒玉牌，是南斗第一星君司命星君！其后五人，司禄、延寿、益算、度厄、上生，六位星君。
“……臣等伏请天尊开恩，容臣等提前显化名讳于下界。臣等掌南斗六司，注人生死寿禄，万年以来兢兢业业不敢懈怠！然则天道定数，将臣等名讳显化之期定在东晋，实在太晚。”司命星君声如洪钟，朗朗说道。
其余五司具道：“那张道陵于东汉便创天师道，待到东晋之时，葛洪、寇谦之诸辈将道统铺展开来，天庭诸神归位，三山五岳，城隍土地，四海龙王，满天星斗，哪一个不比臣等先到？到那时，人间香火早被瓜分殆尽，留给臣等的还能剩几缕？实在不公！”
说到此处，南斗六星泣不成声又哭诉道：
“我等勤恳万年，未得半点香火，那三山五岳的山神，不过千载神仙，如今都有了些许微末供奉，虽说不多，好歹占了个先。待到封神之后，哪吒、杨戬、雷部诸将，个个都有香火庙宇。咱们南斗六星排到东晋才显化，实在不甘。”
玉皇大天尊端坐御座，垂珠微晃，并不言语，只静静听着。
贪狼七人立在殿门处，面面相觑。
巨门凑到贪狼耳边，粗声低语：“大哥，南斗六星也来了，还来得比咱们早！”
“眼睛没瞎，我看得见。”贪狼白了他一眼。
他心中暗骂不迭：来得忒不是时候！南斗六星君正在哭穷叫苦，他们北斗七星若此时也上前请旨，说“臣等也想提前显化”，那跟南斗有何分别？
更要命的是，他绝不能在南斗六星面前暴露下界已有人念出北斗真名之事。那可是北斗独有的机缘！若让这六个知道了，还不得闹翻天？
文曲星君显然也想到了此节，不动声色地往贪狼身侧靠了靠，以神念传音道：“大兄，万万不可提北斗法门之事，稳住。”
贪狼微微颔首。
禄存把如意别回袖中，也传音道：“那咱们找什么由头？”
“先听着，看天尊如何答复南斗再说。”贪狼回了一句，七人便默契地束手而立，做出一副“臣等恰好路过”的模样。
御座之上，玉皇大天尊终于开了口。
不急不缓，声若天钟平鸣：“司命，你所奏之事，朕已知晓，然则不可。尔等名讳何时显化于世，乃天定之数，非朕一言可改。天道运转，自有其序，日月经天，江河行地，岂可因一己之私便乱了章程？”
“不过尔等也莫灰心，大衍之数五十，其用四十有九，天道虽定，终留一线变数，若是有缘，尔等或许可以再秦朝之前显化于世。至于这变数何时来、从何来、应在何人身上，朕亦不可言，天道亦不可言。尔等若有缘，自逢其会；若无缘，急亦无用。”
闻言，南斗六星与北斗七星都惊了一下。

于秦朝之前显化于世？那个时期虽以供神，但大多不知名讳，也极其稀少，如果能在那个时期显化于世，或许能在东汉之前脱离神职，名入三山。
南斗六星自然不认为天尊会诓骗他们，这绝对是真，只是不知变数于何处。
六人得了一些内部消息，心情好了些许，转身便往殿外退去。经过北斗七星身旁时，司命星君顿了顿步子，目光在贪狼等人面上扫了一圈，狐疑道：“咦？你们北斗七星怎的也在此处？”
贪狼早有准备，大袖一摆，哈哈笑道：“路过路过！闲来无事，见灵霄殿热闹，便进来瞧瞧。”
司命星君鄙夷的瞥了贪狼一眼：“无事路过灵霄宝殿？没有天尊法旨你能进来？”
贪狼尴尬一笑，也意识到话中漏洞，只是不知作何解释，只得讪笑。
正尴尬间，只听得御座之上，玉皇大天尊轻喝一声：“尔等心思，朕已知晓。南斗注生，北斗注死，不可擅动下界？都退下吧！”
言讫，大天尊大袖一挥，只听“呼”的一声，平地卷起一阵罡风，南斗六星与北斗七星连个“遵旨”都没来得及说，便如落叶般被一并扫出灵霄宝殿，滴溜溜滚落在通明殿外。
司命星君稳住身形，理了理星袍，狐疑地盯着贪狼等人：“你这老贪狼，休要瞒我！大天尊方才说‘尔等心思’，分明是说你们想下界！你们这七个老儿，平日里躲在星宫里孵蛋，今日齐聚于此，定有猫腻！”
贪狼星君打了个哈哈，连连摆手：“哪里哪里，真就是闲来逛逛，顺道听听天尊教诲。几位兄弟，咱们星宫的丹炉还烧着呢，扯呼！”
说罢，使个眼色，北斗七星化作七道流光，呲溜一下溜得无影无踪，端的是比兔子还快。
司命星君望着他们远去的背影，冷笑一声：“哼！这群老滑头，定是嗅到了什么下界的机缘！走，咱们回头备些仙酒，单找巨门那个憨匹夫套套话去，他那嘴上没个把门的，几口黄汤下肚，一诈便知！”
按下天庭诸神暗中较劲不提，却说那下界南瞻部洲伏龙山上，陶潜突然断了存北斗法的咒言。
不是他不想修行，是云笈道枢有了反应。
“传《三真火法》于后人，得《法天象地》！”
呵！又是一门顶天立地的大神通！陶潜乐得胡子直翘，心道这猴子当真是个聚宝盆。
这几日，那猴子尝到了甜头，整日里活蹦乱跳，抓耳挠腮地缠着陶潜：“陶老道，陶老道！我这火法已然纯熟，能烧山能烤肉，你再教我些别的通天本事罢！”
陶潜举起拐杖便作势欲打，骂道：“你这泼猴，贪多嚼不烂！法术岂是儿戏？你且自己去后山将那火法再练个千百遍，莫来烦我！”
其实哪里是陶潜不肯教？实则是他自己会的法术本就不多，若是三两下便被这悟性逆天的猴子学了去，往后拿什么震慑他？
故而这几日，陶潜借口闭关，实则躲在竹屋内，没日没夜地苦修那刚得来的《七十二变》，只为多攒些家底，好拖延些传法的进度。

content_en:
Seven star kings entered the palace.
But he saw six figures already standing under the Nine Dragon Throne. The leader is wearing a Luanjin star robe, a purple micro crown on his head, and a six-pointed jade plaque hanging from his waist. He is the number one star in the South Dou, Siming Xingjun! The next five people are Si Lu, Yanshou, Yisuan, Duhe, Shangsheng, and the six star kings.
"... I ask Heavenly Lord to show mercy, and allow me to reveal my name to the lower realm in advance. I am in charge of the Six Divisions of Nandou, focusing on life, death and longevity. I have been working hard for thousands of years and dare not slack off! However, the way of heaven has determined that the time for the manifestation of my name and name will be in the Eastern Jin Dynasty. It is too late." Si Mingxingjun said loudly like a bell.
The remaining five ministers said: "Zhang Daoling established the Tao of Heavenly Masters in the Eastern Han Dynasty. By the time of the Eastern Jin Dynasty, Ge Hong and Kou Qian spread the Taoism, and the gods of heaven returned to their thrones. The three mountains and five mountains, the land of the city god, the dragon kings of the four seas, and the sky full of stars. Which one would not arrive earlier than the ministers? By then, the incense in the world would have been divided up, and how many strands would be left to the ministers? It is really unfair!"
Speaking of this, Nandou Liuxing burst into tears and cried again:
"We have been working hard for ten thousand years, but we have not obtained any incense. The mountain gods of the three mountains and five mountains, who have been immortals for thousands of years, now have some minor worship. Although it is not much, at least they have taken the lead. After becoming gods, Nezha, Yang Jian, and the Leibu generals all have incense temples. We, the Six Stars of the South Dou, waited until the Eastern Jin Dynasty to manifest. We are really unwilling to do so."
The Jade Emperor, the Great Heavenly Lord, sat upright on his throne, his hanging beads slightly swaying, and said nothing, only listening quietly.
The seven greedy wolves stood at the door of the palace, looking at each other.
Jumen leaned close to Tanlang's ear and whispered harshly: "Brother, the Six Stars of the South Dipper are here too, and they came earlier than us!"
"I'm not blind, I can see." Tanlang rolled his eyes at him.
He cursed secretly in his heart: It couldn't come at a worse time! Nandou Liuxing Lord is crying and complaining. If they, Big Dipper Qixing, come forward to ask for orders at this time and say, "I also want to manifest in advance," what is the difference between Nandou and Nandou?
What's even more critical is that he must not reveal in front of the Six Stars of the South Dipper that someone in the lower realm has pronounced Beidou's true name. That is Beidou’s unique opportunity! If these six people knew about it, wouldn't they cause a huge commotion?
Lord Wenquxing had obviously thought of this as well. He quietly leaned against Greedy Wolf and said with his spiritual mind: "Brother, you must not mention the Beidou Dharma Sect. Stay still."
Greedy Wolf nodded slightly.
Lucun put Ruyi back into his sleeve and said via voice: "Then what reason are we looking for?"
"Listen first, let's see how Tianzun responds to Nandou." Tanlang replied, and the seven of them stood with their hands tied in a tacit understanding, pretending to be "I'm just passing by."
On the throne, the Jade Emperor finally spoke.
There is no hurry or delay, and the sound is like a bell ringing in the sky: "Sir Ming, I already know what you have told me, but I can't do it. When these names and taboos will appear in the world is a number determined by heaven, and I can't change it with a word. The movement of heaven has its own order, the sun and moon pass through the sky, and the rivers run through the earth. How can the regulations be messed up because of my own selfishness?"
"But don't be discouraged. The number of the Great Evolution is fifty, and its usefulness is nine out of forty. Although the way of heaven is fixed, there is still a slight variable. If you are destined, you may be able to manifest in the world before the Qin Dynasty. As for when this variable will come, where it comes from, and who it should be, I can't say it, and the way of heaven can't say it. If you are destined, you will meet it; if you are not destined, it is useless to worry."
Hearing this, both South Dipper and Big Dipper were startled.
Appeared in the world before the Qin Dynasty? Although they were worshiped by gods during that period, most of them were unknown and extremely rare. If they could manifest themselves into the world during that period, they might be able to leave the priesthood before the Eastern Han Dynasty and become famous in the Three Mountains.
Nandou Liuxing naturally didn't think that Tianzun would deceive them. This was definitely true, but they didn't know where the variables were.
After getting some inside information, the six of them felt a little better, turned around and retreated out of the palace. When passing by Big Dipper, Si Mingxing paused, his eyes swept around Tanlang and others, and said suspiciously: "Eh? You Big DipperWhy are you here? "
Greedy Wolf was already prepared, waved his sleeves and laughed, "I'm just passing by! When I had nothing to do, I saw the excitement in Lingxiao Hall, so I came in to take a look. "
Si Mingxingjun glanced at Tanlang with disdain: "Passing by Lingxiao Palace without anything? Can you come in without Heavenly Lord’s decree? "
Greedy Wolf smiled awkwardly, realizing the flaw in his words, but he didn't know how to explain it, so he could only laugh.
In the midst of embarrassment, I heard the Jade Emperor from above the throne shout softly: "I already know your thoughts. The Nandou is for life, the Beidou is for death, so you can't touch the lower realm without permission? Everyone, please step back! "
After saying that, the Great Heavenly Lord waved his sleeves, and there was a sound of "huh", and a strong wind blew up from the ground. The South Dipper and the Big Dipper didn't even have time to say "obey the order", they were swept out of the Lingxiao Palace like fallen leaves, and fell outside the Tongming Hall.
Si Ming Xingjun stabilized his figure, straightened his star robe, and stared at Tan Lang and others suspiciously: "You old greedy wolf, don't try to hide it from me! The Great Heavenly Lord just said "your thoughts", it clearly means that you want to go to the lower world! You seven old men, who usually hide in the Star Palace to hatch eggs, gathered here today, there must be something fishy! "
Lord Greedy Wolf Star laughed and waved his hands repeatedly: "Wherever I am, I just want to hang out and listen to Tianzun's teachings. Brothers, the alchemy furnace in our Star Palace is still burning, wow! "
After that, with a wink, the Big Dipper turned into seven streams of light, and disappeared without a trace, faster than a rabbit.
Lord Si Mingxing looked at their retreating figures and sneered: "Hmph! These old cunning guys must have smelled some opportunity in the lower world! Come on, let's go back and prepare some fairy wine, and just talk to that stupid guy from Jumen. He has no clue what he's talking about, and after a few mouthfuls of yellow soup, he'll know when he's cheating! "
Not mentioning the secret rivalry between the gods in heaven, but saying that on Fulong Mountain in the south of the lower realm, Tao Qian suddenly broke the curse of saving the Beidou method.
It's not that he doesn't want to practice, it's that Daoshu Yunji reacted.
"Pass the "Three True Fire Methods" to future generations and obtain the "Dharma of Heaven and Earth"! "
Ha! Another incredible magical power! Tao Qian was so happy that his beard stood straight up, thinking that this monkey was really a cornucopia.
In the past few days, the monkey had tasted the sweetness and was jumping around all day long, scratching his head and pestering Tao Qian: "Old Tao, Tao Old Tao! I'm already proficient in fire skills, I can burn mountains and roast meat, so you can teach me some other powerful skills! "
Tao Qian raised his crutch and was about to hit him, and cursed: "You are a monkey, you can't chew off more than you can chew! Is magic a child's play? Just go to the back mountain and practice the fire technique a thousand times, and don't bother me! "
In fact, why was Tao Qian unwilling to teach? In fact, he doesn't know many spells himself. If this monkey with incredible understanding learns them in just a few times, what will he do to scare him in the future?
Therefore, in the past few days, Tao Qian used the excuse of retreat, but in fact he was hiding in a bamboo house, studying the "Seventy-two Transformations" he had just obtained day and night, just to save more money and delay the progress of teaching the Dharma.
